grammar.name: blocks are numbered across the message, and a broken one keeps its number
a menu with anything but buttons, a button with markup, or no buttons is invalid
fenced code, code spans, and indented code are not blocks
a CRLF fence keeps its menu inert
a tilde fence with CRLF line endings keeps its menu inert
a backtick fence keeps its menu inert after a blank line
a CRLF backtick fence keeps its menu inert after a blank line
a fence opened with CRLF closes with LF, and a menu after it is live
a fence opened with LF closes with CRLF, and a menu after it is live
an unclosed CRLF fence keeps everything after it inert
a lone carriage return ends a fence's info string, so a backtick after it is inside the fence
an info string may hold a line separator
a code span that crosses a line keeps a menu inside it inert
a blockquote, a tab, or four spaces never start a block
a menu still streaming is held back and not numbered
a last line that may still become a block is held back
a media layout figure stays a layout, and a menu after it is block 0
